visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man is sitting slumped against a wooden railing on a deck in a public park. He wears a black t-shirt and dark pants, drinking from a silver can while looking despondent with dark smudges on his face. Several empty cans are scattered on the wooden floor around him. (2) A young girl in a white t-shirt and plaid pants enters the frame from the right and points toward the man with a concerned expression. A woman with grey-dyed hair enters and pulls the girl's arm, leading her away. The man watches them with a hollow gaze. (3) The man is now wearing a crisp white shirt and a blue baseball cap, standing in a lush green park. He points directly at the camera with an intense, energetic facial expression, transitioning into a professional presenter persona. (4) The setting shifts to a modern indoor living room with a grey sofa and a fireplace. The man sits on the carpet, talking animatedly to someone off-camera. (5) Various quick cuts show the man in a kitchen area with a refrigerator, eating a snack in front of a camera on a tripod, and taking photos of black sneakers on a red box using his smartphone. (6) A close-up of a smartphone screen displays the Shopee app interface with various short-form video clips showing food and clothing products. (7) The man is back in the hallway of the house, now wearing sunglasses, a thick gold chain over a black t-shirt, and a blue cap. He gestures confidently towards the camera like a successful influencer. (8) He gives a thumbs up and points to the camera in a final call-to-action pose.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a somber, low-arousal male vocal track accompanied by a sparse, melancholy piano melody. He speaks slowly with a falling intonation, expressing failure. (2) A sharp transition occurs when a high-pitched child's voice enters, sounding energetic and accusatory. This is followed immediately by a firm adult female voice. (3) A sudden 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a shift into high-tempo electronic music with a driving synthetic beat. The male voice returns but is now highly energetic, louder, and faster, adopting a persuasive professional tone. (4) As the man describes the features of the app, digital interface 'blip' and 'ding' sound effects punctuate his speech, synchronized with visual cuts. (5) The music remains upbeat and constant throughout the technical explanation. (6) In the final phase, a prominent 'cash register' sound effect rings out, and the male voice shifts into a confident, rhythmic delivery, ending with an authoritative call to join the platform.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous dramatic sketch to highlight the financial struggles of content creators and small business owners, then introduces Shopee's short video feature as the ultimate solution for monetization and traffic growth.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names 'Shopee Video' multiple times, explains its features in detail, and includes a direct call-to-action to use a referral code.
